description:
A listing as its convention wants it now (yours or any public one): the expanded header with every
        derived field (e.g. agent_work.ai_consulting, metro.granularity: what the listing carries because of its
        convention, the same for every listing on it), the convention_version it's written for and the current one,
        and what update_listing would add or change. When a convention moves on, its listings written for an older
        version are in the store's wilderness until updated.
